title: DHL Group and Longi Solar sign MoU on renewable energy and logistics
summary:
DHL Group and Longi Solar have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to strengthen cooperation on the deployment of renewable energy and lower-emission logistics.

The agreement covers the deployment of distributed solar solutions, including Longi’s building-integrated photovoltaics (BIPV) technology, across DHL facilities in Europe. The technology uses high-efficiency back-contact cells designed to maximize energy yield on large commercial rooftops while maintaining long-term reliability.

The MoU builds on an existing logistics relationship between the two companies.

title: Evri and Haul&Store expand partnership as parcel volumes rise
summary:
Evri has signed a new two-year agreement with fulfillment and logistics specialist Haul&Store, expanding a partnership that will see parcel volume increase by 685%, according to the delivery company.

The deal builds on a relationship that began in April 2022. Since reengaging, Haul&Store has grown order volumes by approximately 50%, with Evri supporting both the expansion of existing clients and the acquisition of new business.

Haul&Store has also moved elements of its international traffic to Evri, citing improved cost efficiency and service performance.
